description: Advanced TidGen Power System - ProteusDS Version 2.43.5 Files is a data set deposited in DOE National Library of the Rockies (NLR) Repository by its authors Cian Marnagh, Jarlath McEntee. The TidGen Power System generates emission-free electricity from tidal currents and connects directly into existing grids using smart grid technology. The power system consists of three major subsystems: shore-side power electronics, mooring system, and turbine generator unit (TGU) device.
